gen-gf-revalia-gf-tiny5: Loud, loose and wide-striding, Revalia sets a tall band of letters with an open-curved g across the top. But Tiny5 is tall and tidy, so its ascenders look short and the text reads smooth and friendly.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-ubuntu: Ubuntu holds a lofty lowercase band under the loud, bold, wide-striding Revalia and its open-curved g. Ubuntu keeps the text modern and tidy, so paragraphs move along without any fuss.
gen-gf-revalia-sora: Loud letters, widely spaced, with a tall build. Sora's precision is the standout, its curves turning corners with no swell and a c and s held wide apart against Revalia.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-fs-familjen-grotesk: Familjen Grotesk reads lively, a sans with bowls left open on one side and a tall lowercase against its capitals. Shantell Sans earns its keep big and brief, in a single pen width.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-bai-jamjuree: Wide-mouthed and pen-drawn, Shantell Sans keeps one fixed nib width, its openings gaping like a cut tin lid. Bai Jamjuree reads light, round and unpinched, with no swelling or thinning.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-cairo: Cairo reads modern and professional, a sans with a wide channel into every bowl that keeps its letters open. Shantell Sans adds curves as stout as its stems, like cord.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-dotgothic16: Shantell Sans is distinctive, with a mouth wide as a tin lid. Give the heading ample size, and DotGothic16, a sans-serif with tube-like thickness through every bend, will hold up well at smaller sizes.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-doto: Distinctive and marker-drawn, Shantell Sans meets Doto, a sans with wide margins of space around each glyph. Give Doto a bit more size so its generous round mouths can show.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-encode-sans-expa: Light on its feet, with a stroke that never changes weight. Shantell Sans is best at expressive display lines, while Encode Sans Expanded, a sans-serif with c tips pulled well apart, handles the quieter running text.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-encode-sans-sc: Expressive from the very first stroke, Shantell Sans leads. Encode Sans SC, a sans-serif with shallow terminal curls and wide gaps, follows, tidying up the rope-thick curves above it.
